desc:
ZM:R is a re open of Zombie Madness (got striked).

Generic skibidi toilet based siege defense game.
(Big credits to the creator and SBSD)


The game is made by a solo developer, an animator, and a composer.
And no, it is not coherently related to any other zombie defense games. And, it is not for sale.

Make sure to join group and community server if you want further news about games future or sneak peeks.
